name: GitHub Issue TDD BDD Triage
description: Verified GitHub issue events pass a persistent atomic delivery-ID guard before Claude, then publish exactly one managed TDD/BDD comment through the loopback bridge.

versionMetadata.name: Redis LPUSH ingress
versionMetadata.description: Replaced the dead 127.0.0.1:8766 claim/result HTTP calls with a Redis LPUSH to 'triage:queue'. The webhook remains the ingress; a Code node normalizes the payload and the Redis node enqueues it. Model/publish work moves to the new Redis Triage Consumer workflow.
